name: Arholma-Idö runt
description: Northern outer-archipelago route around Arholma and Idö.

safety.exposure: Short traffic-lane crossing at start; exposed east/north sides toward Ålands Hav.

campingRules: Arholma-Idö nature reserve rules need current official verification.

protectionRules.summary: Arholma-Idö reserve rules include leashed dogs, fires only at designated places, two-day tent/boat limits, an Idöfladen motor/anchoring restriction, and bird-protection closure around Rödkobben/Nollekobb.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

rules: Do not tent, moor, pull up or anchor craft at the same place longer than two consecutive days except at established tent areas/jetties.
Do not anchor or operate motor-driven boats in the inner Idöfladen area; kayakers should preserve the shallow marine habitat and avoid disturbance.

seasonalRestrictions.appliesTo: Rödkobben and Nollekobb plus 100 m water zone
seasonalRestrictions.restriction: Landing and entering the water area within 100 m prohibited.

needsFollowup: Verify exact current protection boundaries against Naturvårdsverket Skyddad natur map before public navigation/import.

facilityNotes: Water at Österhamn and near dansbanan per Kanotguiden

needsFollowup: Confirm current public water access and reserve updates.
